arxiv-1806-06020.title: Imbalanced Randomization in Clinical Trials Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-1806-06020.creator: Thevaa Chandereng*, Xiaodan Wei, Rick Chappell
arxiv-1806-06020.description: Abstract Randomization is a common technique used in clinical trials to eliminate potential bias and confounders in a patient population. Equal allocation to treatment groups is the standard due to its optimal efficiency in many cases. However, in certain scenarios, unequal allocation can improve efficiency.

arxiv-2203-10638.title: V2X-ViT: Vehicle-to-Everything Cooperative Perception with Vision Transformer
arxiv-2203-10638.creator: Runsheng Xu, Hao Xiang ⋆, Zhengzhong Tu ⋆, Xin Xia, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Jiaqi Ma †
arxiv-2203-10638.description: Abstract In this paper, we investigate the application of Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communication to improve the perception performance of autonomous vehicles. We present a robust cooperative perception framework with V2X communication using a novel vision Transformer. Specifically, we build a holistic attention model, namely V2X-ViT, to effectively fuse information across on-road agents (i.e., vehicles and infrastructure).

arxiv-2305-18794.title: Understanding temporally weakly supervised training: A case study for keyword spotting
arxiv-2305-18794.creator: Heinrich Dinkel, Weiji Zhuang, Zhiyong Yan, Yongqing Wang, Junbo Zhang, Yujun Wang
arxiv-2305-18794.description: Abstract The currently most prominent algorithm to train keyword spotting (KWS) models with deep neural networks (DNNs) requires strong supervision i.e., precise knowledge of the spoken keyword location in time. Thus, most KWS approaches treat the presence of redundant data, such as noise, within their training set as an obstacle.

arxiv-2405-01203.title: Optimization of reactively sputtered Mn 3 GaN films based on resistivity measurements
arxiv-2405-01203.creator: Christoph Sürgers 1, Gerda Fischer 1, Sihao Deng 2,3, Dongmei Hu 4, Cong Wang 4,5
arxiv-2405-01203.description: Abstract Mn-based nitrides with antiperovskite structures have several properties that can be utilised for antiferromagnetic spintronics. Their magnetic properties depend on the structural quality, composition and doping of the cubic antiperovskite structure. Such nitride thin films are usually produced by reactive physical vapour deposition, where the deposition rate of N can only be controlled by the N 2 gas flow.

arxiv-2503-23028.title: Relativistic mean-field predictions for dense matter equation of state and application to neutron stars
arxiv-2503-23028.creator: Luca Passarella, Jérôme Margueron, Giuseppe Pagliara
arxiv-2503-23028.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Luca Passarella, Jérôme Margueron, Giuseppe Pagliara. Relativistic mean-field models (RMF) based on the exchange of σ \sigma , ω \omega , and ρ \rho mesons including non-linear nucleon- σ \sigma couplings and density-dependent ρ \rho coupling, are considered. A large set of models is generated using the Markov chain Monte Carlo approach and Bayesian statistics to reproduce nuclear physics knowledge encoded in terms of the nuclear empirical parameters and χ \chi EFT predictions for low-density neutron matter.

arxiv-2504-17257.title: Electrohydrodynamic drift of a drop away from an insulating wall
arxiv-2504-17257.creator: Diptendu Sen, Mohammadhossein Firouznia, Jeremy A. Koch, David Saintillan, Petia M. Vlahovska
arxiv-2504-17257.description: Abstract An isolated charge-neutral drop suspended in an unbounded medium does not migrate in a uniform DC electric field. A nearby wall breaks the symmetry and causes the drop to drift towards or away from the boundary, depending on the electric properties of the fluids and the wall.

arxiv-2506-04170.title: Estimation of the reduced density matrix and entanglement entropies using autoregressive networks
arxiv-2506-04170.creator: Piotr Białas, Piotr Korcyl, Tomasz Stebel, Dawid Zapolski
arxiv-2506-04170.description: Abstract We present an application of autoregressive neural networks to Monte Carlo simulations of quantum spin chains using the correspondence with classical two-dimensional spin systems. We use a hierarchy of neural networks capable of estimating conditional probabilities of consecutive spins to evaluate elements of reduced density matrices directly.

arxiv-2507-10457.title: Logic-layer Prompt Control Injection (LPCI): A Novel Security Vulnerability Class in Agentic Systems "This work is not related to the author’s position at Amazon"
arxiv-2507-10457.creator: Hammad Atta, Ken Huang, Manish Bhatt, Kamal Ahmed, Muhammad Aziz Ul Haq, Yasir Mehmood
arxiv-2507-10457.description: Abstract The integration of large language models (LLMs) into enterprise systems has introduced a new class of covert security vulnerabilities, particularly within logic execution layers and persistent memory contexts. This paper introduces Logic-layer Prompt Control Injection (LPCI) , a novel category of attacks that embeds encoded, delayed, and conditionally triggered payloads within memory, vector stores, or tool outputs.

arxiv-2507-15731.title: Relationship between Structure and Dynamics of an Icosahedral Quasicrystal using Unsupervised Machine Learning
arxiv-2507-15731.creator: Edwin A. Bedolla-Montiel, Susana Marín-Aguilar, Marjolein Dijkstra
arxiv-2507-15731.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Edwin A. Bedolla-Montiel, Susana Marín-Aguilar, Marjolein Dijkstra. We present a comprehensive study of the structure, formation, and dynamics of a one-component model system that self-assembles into an icosahedral quasicrystal (IQC). Using molecular dynamics simulations combined with unsupervised machine learning techniques, we identify and characterize the unique structural motifs of IQCs, including icosahedral and dodecahedral arrangements, and quantify the evolution of local environments during the IQC formation process.

arxiv-2508-10634.title: Synthesis of Deep Neural Networks with Safe Robust Adaptive Control for Reliable Operation of Wheeled Mobile Robots
arxiv-2508-10634.creator: Mehdi Heydari Shahna, Jouni Mattila
arxiv-2508-10634.description: Abstract Deep neural networks (DNNs) can enable precise control while maintaining low computational costs by circumventing the need for dynamic modeling. However, the deployment of such black-box approaches remains challenging for heavy-duty wheeled mobile robots (WMRs), which are subject to strict international standards and prone to faults and disturbances.

arxiv-2512-00894.title: Generalized Boltzmann-Gibbs Distribution and the Electronic Partition Function Paradox
arxiv-2512-00894.creator: Leandro Lyra Braga Dognini

arxiv-2601-15275.title: RayRoPE: Projective Ray Positional Encoding for Multi-view Attention
arxiv-2601-15275.description: Abstract We study positional encodings for multi-view transformers that process tokens from a set of posed input images, and seek a mechanism that encodes patches uniquely, allows SE(3)-invariant attention with multi-frequency similarity, and can be adaptive to the geometry of the underlying scene.

arxiv-2602-15632.title: Neural-POD: A Plug-and-Play Neural Operator Framework for Infinite-Dimensional Functional Nonlinear Proper Orthogonal Decomposition
arxiv-2602-15632.creator: Changhong Mou, Binghang Lu, Guang Lin
arxiv-2602-15632.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Changhong Mou, Binghang Lu, Guang Lin. AI for science (AI4Science) models often suffer from discretization: learned representations remain tied to the training grid, limiting transfer across resolutions, solvers and applications. We introduce Neural Proper Orthogonal Decomposition (Neural-POD), a plug-and-play neural operator that learns nonlinear, orthogonal basis functions directly in function space and can be integrated in both projection-based reduced order models and operator-learning frameworks such as DeepONet.

europmc-pmc2603037.title: HOLLOW: generating accurate representations of channel and interior surfaces in molecular structures.
europmc-pmc2603037.creator: Ho BK, Gruswitz F.
europmc-pmc2603037.description: Background An accurate rendering of interior surfaces can facilitate the analysis of mechanisms at atomic-level detail, such as the transport of substrates in the ammonia channel. In molecular viewers, one must remove the exterior surface that obscures the channel surface by cli

pmc-10630943.title: Confocal Raman Spectroscopic Characterization of Dermatopharmacokinetics Ex Vivo
pmc-10630943.creator: Panagiota Zarmpi, M Alice Maciel Tabosa, Pauline Vitry, Annette L Bunge, Natalie A Belsey, Dimitrios Tsikritsis, Timothy J Woodman, M Begoña Delgado-Charro, Richard H Guy
pmc-10630943.description: Confocal Raman spectroscopy is being assessed as a tool with which to quantify the rate and extent of drug uptake to and its clearance from target sites of action within the viable epidermis below the skin’s stratum corneum (SC) barrier.

pmc-10681503.title: A review on nondiabetic hypoglycemia from various causes: Case series report
pmc-10681503.creator: Lulu Gan, Xuan Zhu, Yue Gao, Mingyao Zhong, Shibo Liao, Gao Huang, Yimin Yan
pmc-10681503.description: Rationale:Hypoglycemia is common in patients with glucose regulation disorders and related diabetic treatments but is rare in nondiabetic patients. Severe hypoglycemia can cause harm to patients’ cognition, consciousness, central nervous system, cardiovascular and cerebrovascular system, and even death. However, the most fundamental way to control hypoglycemia is to identify the cause and deal with the primary disease.

pmc-10689679.title: A Mini Review of the Impact of Baseline Disease Severity on Clinical Outcomes: Should We Compare Atopic Dermatitis Clinical Trials?
pmc-10689679.creator: Jonathan I Silverberg, Selwyn Ho, Raúl Collazo
pmc-10689679.description: Based on clinical trials of systemic treatments in adults with moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis (AD) reported between 2014 and 2023, we used linear regression to investigate relationships between baseline Eczema Area and Severity Index (EASI) scores and (1) study start date, (2) EASI response, and (3) rescue medication rates.

pmc-11672975.title: Alterations in Glutathione Redox Homeostasis in Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Fatty Liver Disease: A Systematic Review
pmc-11672975.creator: Lucia Cesarini, Flavia Grignaffini, Anna Alisi, Anna Pastore, Alessandra Napolitano
pmc-11672975.description: Low molecular weight (LMW) thiols, particularly glutathione, play pathogenic roles in various multiorgan diseases. The liver is central for the production and systemic distribution of LMW thiols; thus, it is particularly susceptible to the imbalance of redox status that may determine increased oxidative stress and trigger the liver damage observed in metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) models and humans.

pmc-13097563.title: Establishment of Reference Intervals for Plasma TSH Across the Lifespan in an Algerian Mediterranean Population
pmc-13097563.creator: Said Ali, Hadia Boussaha, Lydia Asma Nibou, Meriem Harhad, Maya Nouali, Zineb Larab, Djamila Messaoudene, Amel Fatma Safer‐Tabi, Lylia Djidjeli, Fatma Merah, Lylia Meriem Berkani, Lydia Lamara Mahammed, Brahim Belaid, Ines Allam, Samia Achir, Lyèce Yargui, Reda Djidjik
pmc-13097563.description: BackgroundThyroid‐stimulating hormone (TSH) serves as a sensitive marker of thyroid function; however, its interpretation is subject to variation across different populations due to physiological, environmental, and methodological factors. Currently, no validated TSH reference intervals (RIs) have been established for the Algerian population.

pmc-13246101.title: Construction and validation of a machine learning model to predict the sarcopenic obesity population
pmc-13246101.creator: Mingrong Zhang, Dandan Dong, Chenming Liu, Yuxing Liu, Zhenfu Zhang
pmc-13246101.description: Sarcopenic obesity (SO) imposes a heavy medical burden on both individuals and society, highlighting the importance of early identification and timely intervention. This study aims to construct a clinical prediction model based on machine learning (ML) methods to assist in the early screening of SO.

pmc-13333142.title: Oral guanfacine treatment ameliorates the ADHD-like symptoms caused by developmental manganese exposure
pmc-13333142.creator: Ellie Fisher, Stephane A. Beaudin, Barbara J. Strupp, Donald R. Smith
pmc-13333142.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Epidemiological studies have linked developmental manganese (Mn) exposure to increased risk of ADHD and related symptoms in children and adolescents. Rodent model studies have 1) confirmed causality by demonstrating that developmental Mn exposure can cause lasting ADHD-like symptoms, 2) revealed that these symptoms (in Mn-exposed animals) are accompanied by a hypofunctioning catecholaminergic system in fronto-cortical-striatal brain areas, and 3) demonstrated that methylphenidate is efficacious in ameliorating these ADHD-like symptoms in Mn-exposed animals.

pmc-13571991.title: New treatments in myositis on the horizon
pmc-13571991.creator: Ingrid E Lundberg
pmc-13571991.description: The idiopathic inflammatory myopathies (IIM), or briefly myositis, are a heterogeneous group of rare autoimmune diseases with high morbidity and mortality. Current treatment is based on high doses of glucocorticoids over long periods of time in combination with immunosuppressive drugs, with varying and often disappointing results. Therefore, there is a high unmet need for new therapies.

pmc-13578286.title: Dietary approaches to stop hypertension (DASH) in relation to hyper-triglyceridemic-waist (HTGW) phenotype in Iranian adults
pmc-13578286.creator: Masoud Pirmoradian, Alireza Parvaresh, Zahra Moradmand, Farnaz Shahdadian, Parisa Rouhani, Sepideh Soltani, Parvane Saneei
pmc-13578286.description: Several studies have revealed a significant link between dietary approaches to stop hypertension (DASH) and the hypertriglyceridemia-waist (HTGW) phenotype, but some others did not. To clarify this association, we conducted a cross-sectional study to explore the connection between DASH diet adherence and HTGW phenotype in Iranian adults. This study was conducted among Iranian adults (n = 528) living in Isfahan.
